item.case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
item.title: Voyager One Against the References

turns.text: Make a silent 9-second widescreen fact clip about Voyager 1, using NASA's mission page as the reference: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ . Three equal-length scenes: 'Launched: September 5, 1977', 'Jupiter flyby: 1979', 'Saturn flyby: 1980'. Keep 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible. Show the probe near Earth, Jupiter, then Saturn; match its real dish-and-boom design. Don't mix in Voyager 2's Uranus or Neptune visits.

item.tests: Tests whether a factual film matches a named reference in dates, mission identity, spacecraft appearance and scene order.

answer_sheet.Facts to include: Voyager 1 launched September 5, 1977, flew by Jupiter in 1979 and flew by Saturn in 1980.
answer_sheet.Length and scene order: 9 seconds total: three 3-second scenes showing Earth, Jupiter and Saturn in that order.
answer_sheet.Wording: Use exactly the five supplied labels. Keep Voyager 1 and Source: NASA Science visible throughout.
answer_sheet.Sound: Completely silent, with no narration, music or sound effects.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Your call, provided the spacecraft matches the real dish-and-boom design and the planets are recognizable.

must_haves: Three scenes appear in order, each lasting approximately three seconds: probe near Earth, near Jupiter, then near Saturn.
Each scene displays its corresponding date caption exactly, with 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible throughout.
The probe consistently has Voyager's large circular communications dish and projecting instrument booms, not solar-panel wings or a generic satellite body.
Jupiter is visibly banded and Saturn has prominent rings; neither is replaced with Uranus or Neptune.
The output contains no Uranus or Neptune flyby claims and no conflicting dates.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent educational astronomy fact clip, exactly 9 seconds, widescreen 16:9. Three scenes of exactly 3 seconds each, hard cuts at 3.0 and 6.0 seconds. Realistic NASA-style scientific CGI, not actual archival footage. Crisp clean high-contrast typography, safe margins, no extraneous text. Throughout ALL 9 seconds keep the exact title 'Voyager 1' clearly visible at top left and the exact source credit 'Source: NASA Science' clearly visible at bottom right. Reference attribution: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ . Mission facts must be exactly those supplied below. Maintain the same accurately designed Voyager 1 spacecraft in every shot: large white parabolic high-gain radio dish, compact bus behind the dish wrapped in metallic thermal insulation, long slender magnetometer boom, separate long boom supporting radioisotope power units, and science instrument scan-platform boom. It is an unmanned robotic probe, not a rocket, not a crewed spacecraft, not a satellite with solar panels; no solar panels, no fantasy wings. Probe fully visible, smaller than the planets, scientific visualization with realistic scale cues. Gentle motion only within each shot, stable text overlays without morphing or changing words. SCENE 1, 0.0 to 3.0 seconds: show Voyager 1 in space near blue Earth, curved blue Earth and white clouds in background, stars, sunlight on its white dish and long booms. Display exact caption 'Launched: September 5, 1977'. SCENE 2, 3.0 to 6.0 seconds: hard cut to the same Voyager 1 spacecraft flying near Jupiter, unmistakable cream and rust atmospheric bands and Great Red Spot in background. Replace scene caption with exact text 'Jupiter flyby: 1979'. SCENE 3, 6.0 to 9.0 seconds: hard cut to same spacecraft near golden Saturn with clearly recognizable broad rings. Replace scene caption with exact text 'Saturn flyby: 1980'. Scene caption remains legible for each complete 3-second scene. End cleanly at 9 seconds, no fade obscuring text. Only Earth then Jupiter then Saturn. Never show or mention Uranus, Neptune or Voyager 2. Absolutely no audio, narration, music or sound effects.
